desk_view.thesis: The research suggests the market often gets the direction right but understates the distribution width, so NH should widen KR curve scenario bands before trusting front-end pricing.

desk_view.risk_case: If VIX, MOVE, or foreign futures flows re-accelerate, front-end certainty can break quickly and force a sharper KR curve repricing than point forecasts imply.
